summary: Master corporate governance for emerging markets. Learn OECD & IFC frameworks to mitigate risk and attract capital. Enroll in our 5-day expert-led course.
lede: Corporate governance training helps board secretaries, legal counsel, directors and risk leaders strengthen oversight amid regulatory uncertainty. It develops practical skills in assessing governance gaps, shaping board structures and controls, managing risk, shareholder rights and stakeholder engagement, and conducting formal board evaluations through applied exercises.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for high-level professionals responsible for the integrity and strategic direction of organizations operating in emerging economies.
modules: Governance Foundations in Emerging Market Contexts
International Frameworks and Local Regulatory Alignment
Risk Management and Internal Control Systems
Digital Governance and AI Boardroom Oversight
prerequisites: Participants should hold a senior management or board-level role and possess a foundational understanding of business law or financial reporting. Experience in risk management, legal counsel, or corporate secretarial functions is highly recommended to maximize the value of the intermediate-level strategic simulations.
